preconditions.expression: root is None or (hasattr(root, 'data') and hasattr(root, 'left') and hasattr(root, 'right') and hasattr(root, 'random'))
preconditions.description: The input root is either None or a valid node object containing data, left, right, and random attributes.
If the root exists, its data value is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: root is None or (root.left is None or (hasattr(root.left, 'data') and hasattr(root.left, 'left') and hasattr(root.left, 'right') and hasattr(root.left, 'random'))
preconditions.description: If the root exists, its left child (if present) is a valid node with the required attributes.

preconditions.expression: root is None or (root.right is None or (hasattr(root.right, 'data') and hasattr(root.right, 'left') and hasattr(root.right, 'right') and hasattr(root.right, 'random'))
preconditions.description: If the root exists, its right child (if present) is a valid node with the required attributes.

preconditions.expression: root is None or (root.random is None or (hasattr(root.random, 'data') and hasattr(root.random, 'left') and hasattr(root.random, 'right') and hasattr(root.random, 'random'))
preconditions.description: If the root exists, its random pointer (if present) points to a valid node within the tree structure.

postconditions.expression: return_value is None if root is None else (hasattr(return_value, 'data') and hasattr(return_value, 'left') and hasattr(return_value, 'right') and hasattr(return_value, 'random'))
postconditions.description: The returned value is None if input is None, otherwise it is a valid node object with all required attributes.

postconditions.expression: root is None or return_value.data == root.data
postconditions.description: The cloned root has the same data value as the original root.

postconditions.expression: root is None or (return_value.left is None if root.left is None else (hasattr(return_value.left, 'data') and return_value.left.data == root.left.data))
postconditions.description: The left child of the cloned root matches the structure and data of the original left child.

postconditions.expression: root is None or (return_value.right is None if root.right is None else (hasattr(return_value.right, 'data') and return_value.right.data == root.right.data))
postconditions.description: The right child of the cloned root matches the structure and data of the original right child.

postconditions.expression: root is None or (return_value.random is None if root.random is None else (hasattr(return_value.random, 'data') and return_value.random.data == root.random.data))
postconditions.description: The random pointer of the cloned root points to a node with the same data as the original random pointer target.

postconditions.expression: root is None or return_value is not root
postconditions.description: The cloned tree is a distinct object from the original tree.
